I have resolved the `NetworkOnMainThreadException` by offloading the blocking network call to a background coroutine dispatcher.

### Cause
In [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L25-L36), `CatalogClient().fetchCatalog()` was being invoked synchronously directly within the button's `setOnClickListener` callback on Android's main (UI) thread, triggering StrictMode's `NetworkOnMainThreadException`.

### Solution
Updated [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c3-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L25-L36):
- Launched a coroutine using `lifecycleScope.launch`.
- Dispatched the blocking call to `Dispatchers.IO` using `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`.
- Assigned the resulting catalog text or error message back to `output.text` safely on the main thread.
